---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem or Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it enables.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🎨 Design / UI Mockup (optional)

If the feature affects the UI, provide sketches, mockups, or descriptions of how it should look.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches or features that might solve the same problem?

## 📊 Priority

How important is this feature to you?
- [ ] Critical - Game is unusable without it
- [ ] High - Significantly improves experience
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Would be cool but not essential

## 🎮 Game Impact

Which aspects of the game would this affect?
- [ ] Core gameplay mechanics
- [ ] UI/UX
- [ ] Web3 integration
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Audio/Visual
- [ ] Other (specify)

## 💻 Technical Considerations

Any technical details, challenges, or implementation ideas you can share?

## 📚 Examples

Are there other games or apps that implement something similar? Share links or descriptions.

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues or discussions.

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or information about the feature request here.

---

**Thank you for helping improve Hemi Shadow Runner!** 🎮✨
